# alfred ai — Complete Reference

> alfred ai is an agentic AI platform purpose-built for the construction, property, and professional services industries. It automates admin-heavy workflows — project management, document processing, client communications, bidding, and compliance — saving teams 15+ hours per week with typical ROI in 90 days.

## 1. Company Overview

alfred ai is an Australian AI technology company building agentic AI systems for industries traditionally underserved by generic automation tools. The platform combines large language models, workflow orchestration, and industry-specific knowledge to eliminate repetitive administrative work.

### Core Statistics
- 70% reduction in administrative tasks
- 15+ hours saved per week per team
- ROI typically achieved within 90 days
- Works with existing tech stacks — no migration required

### Mission
To free construction and professional service teams from administrative burden so they can focus on building, creating, and delivering value.

---

## 2. Products & Solutions

### Core Product Suite

#### Axiom — Custom AI learning for your business (/products/axiom)
Machine learning trained on your data, processes, and decisions, turning institutional knowledge into models that sharpen the more your business runs.
- Bespoke model training on your historical data, documents, and decision patterns
- Learns from estimates, schedules, and outcomes; accuracy compounds with every project
- Trained and deployed within governed, private boundaries

#### Butler — Agentic AI that serves your teams (/products/butler)
Always-on agents embedded inside your workflows that handle repetitive coordination and follow-ups, scaling output without scaling headcount.
- Always-on agents with no dropped tasks
- Embedded in the tools and processes you already use
- Human-in-the-loop approvals where they matter

#### Watch — Forward intelligence for owners and operators (/products/watch)
Predictive signals that surface risk and opportunity with lead time to act, instead of reacting after the fact.
- Forward-looking indicators across projects and pipeline
- Owner-level visibility across the whole business
- Prioritised, actionable signals — not noise

#### Omega — Living Intelligence (/products/omega)
Your organisation's living memory — holds every workflow, lesson, and decision the business has ever produced; generates the right SOP for the job at hand; and makes it available to your people and Butler agents with human approval at every consequential step.
- Living organisational memory that learns from every project
- SOP and playbook generation from real business history
- Human approval at every consequential step

#### AccountableOS — The central operating system for accountable work (/products/accountable-os)
Unifies Axiom, Butler, Watch, and Omega inside one accountable system with enterprise-grade governance, secure deployment, continuous monitoring, audit trails, and industry verticals for construction and contracting. Powered by Accountable.link.

#### EVA — Secure personal AI inside enterprise work (/products/eva)
A two-way AI security guard that lets employees and contractors use personal AI without exposing enterprise data or injecting private personal memory into company workflows.
- Two-way security guard controlling outbound and inbound AI collaboration
- DLP and redaction of client names, project details, amounts, and personal identifiers
- Personal data firewall blocking private chat history, opinions, and confidential third-party data
- Human approval both ways, critical secret blocking (passwords, API keys, tokens)
- Enterprise-only mode and full audit logging
- Interactive demo: https://eva.alfredai.app/demo

### Workflow Automation

Pre-built and custom AI workflows for:
- Project management automation
- Invoice processing and reconciliation
- Scheduling and resource allocation
- Automated reporting and dashboards
- Client follow-up sequences
- Document routing and approvals

### AI Document Processing
- Contract extraction and analysis
- Tender document parsing
- Compliance document management
- Automated data entry from unstructured documents
- PDF, Word, and image processing

### AI Voice Agents
- Inbound call handling and routing
- Outbound appointment scheduling
- Client follow-up calls
- Lead qualification conversations
- After-hours support automation
- Plans: Starter (2 workflows), Growth (5 workflows), Scale (10 workflows), Enterprise (unlimited)

### AI Bid Intelligence (BID)
- Automated tender discovery and matching
- Document analysis and requirement extraction
- Bid/no-bid decision support with scoring
- Response generation and template management
- Competitor analysis
- Win probability assessment

### Contract Review & Analysis
- Clause-by-clause risk analysis
- Traffic light risk scoring (green/amber/red)
- AI-powered amendment suggestions
- Standard comparison (AS4000, NEC, FIDIC)
- Version tracking and change management

### Client Portal
- White-labelled client dashboards
- Real-time project status updates
- Document sharing and collaboration
- Communication hub
- Payment tracking

## 4. Competitive Positioning

### alfred ai vs Generic Automation Tools

| Feature | alfred ai | Zapier/Make/n8n |
|---------|----------|-----------------|
| Industry knowledge | Built-in construction/property expertise | Generic |
| Setup complexity | Pre-built workflows, guided setup | DIY configuration |
| AI capabilities | Agentic AI with reasoning | Basic triggers/actions |
| Document understanding | Native document AI | Requires third-party add-ons |
| Voice agents | Integrated | Not available |
| Support model | Dedicated success team | Self-serve documentation |

## 7. Technical Architecture

### Platform Capabilities
- Cloud-native architecture
- Real-time data processing
- Multi-model AI (combines multiple LLMs for optimal results)
- API-first design for integrations
- Enterprise-grade security
- SOC 2 compliance ready

### Integration Approach
- Connects to existing tools via APIs
- No rip-and-replace required
- Supports common construction and business software
- Custom integration development available
